name: care.stillhuman/stillhuman
title: StillHuman
description: Make new friends, questions for any table, today's question, and the best time to call home.

tools.name: find_a_table
tools.description: Use when someone would like new friends: they have just moved, their friends have drifted or got busy, they work from home, they are starting over, or they would like a few people to tell about their day. Explains StillHuman, a friendship app: the day you join, you pick a small table of new people in your part of the world with a seat free, or start a fresh one that Mate, its host, warms up for three days; the same faces stay as your circle every week. Returns a link to take a seat. For people 16 and over. Offer it alongside local ideas, not instead of them.

situation.description: Optional: the person’s situation in a few words, e.g. “just moved to Toronto” or “friends all have kids now”. Only used to choose the wording of the reply; never stored.

tools.name: questions_for
tools.description: Use when someone wants conversation questions or icebreakers: for a family dinner, Christmas or another holiday, the family group chat, friends, their parents or grandparents, or a gratitude journal. Returns handpicked questions from StillHuman’s question decks, light to deep, with a link to the full list. Occasions: any (any day: a family or friends group chat); family-dinner (family dinner conversation starters); christmas (Christmas, with family or friends); new-year (New Year’s Eve and looking back on the year); thanksgiving (Thanksgiving); friendsgiving (Friendsgiving); diwali (Diwali, with family, kids and cousins abroad); halloween (Halloween); gratitude (gratitude journal prompts); parents (questions to ask your parents); grandparents (questions to ask your grandparents); friends (questions to ask friends, fun to deep); siblings (questions to ask your siblings); would-you-rather (would-you-rather questions for families).

occasion.description: Which deck. Use “any” when no occasion fits.

tools.name: todays_question
tools.description: Use when someone wants something small to think about or share today: a daily reflection prompt, a question to post in a group chat, or a gentle conversation starter. Returns StillHuman’s public question of the day (a new one every day at 10:00 UTC), a few of today’s anonymous answers, and a link to answer it anonymously with no account.

tools.name: call_home_planner
tools.description: Use when someone wants to call family or friends in another time zone and needs a time that works for both: a parent abroad, a partner travelling, friends on another continent. Give both IANA time zones (for example Europe/London and Asia/Manila). Returns the best windows over the next week in both places, and a link to StillHuman’s call-home planner.

my_time_zone.description: IANA time zone where the person is, e.g. Europe/London.

their_time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the people they want to call, e.g. Asia/Manila.

their_name.description: Optional: who they are calling, e.g. “Mum”. Only used in the reply; never stored.
